commands.name: Assemble the provenance-bound host payload overlay
commands.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(os.environ["CANDIDATE_ROOT"])
REQUIRED_PLATFORMS = {"darwin/amd64", "darwin/arm64", "linux/amd64", "linux/arm64", "windows/amd64", "windows/arm64"}
arguments = [
    sys.executable, "tools/build-host-packages.py",
    "--artifact-stage", os.environ["STAGE_ROOT"],
    "--trusted-source-commit", os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
    "--trusted-workflow", ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    "--trusted-workflow-run", os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
]
receipts = sorted(root.glob("artifact-native-*/artifact-qualification.json"))
if len(receipts) != len(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS):
    raise SystemExit(
        f"expected {len(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS)} exact-host receipts, found {len(receipts)}"
    )
candidates = []
observed_platforms = set()
for receipt in receipts:
    candidate = receipt.parent / "artifact-candidate"
    platform_name = json.loads(receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["platform"]
    observed_platforms.add(platform_name)
    candidates.append((platform_name, candidate, receipt))
if observed_platforms != REQUIRED_PLATFORMS:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"expected exact release cohort {sorted(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS)}, "
        f"found {sorted(observed_platforms)}"
    )
for platform_name, candidate, receipt in sorted(candidates):
    arguments.extend(("--artifact-candidate", str(candidate)))
    arguments.extend(("--artifact-qualification", str(receipt)))
for platform_name in sorted(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS):
    arguments.extend(("--require-platform", platform_name))
completed = subprocess.run(
    arguments, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8"
)
result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    output.write(
        "promotion-receipt-sha256=" + result["promotion_receipt_sha256"] + "\n"
    )
PY

commands.name: Acquire reviewed npm@11.19.1 CLI for Pi assembly
commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
npm_cli_root="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-cli.XXXXXXXX")"
archive="$npm_cli_root/npm.tgz"
curl --disable --fail --show-error --silent --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 \
  --max-redirs 0 \
  --output "$archive" \
  "https://registry.npmjs.org/npm/-/npm-11.19.1.tgz"
ACTUAL_INTEGRITY="sha512-$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "$archive" | openssl base64 -A)"
test "$ACTUAL_INTEGRITY" = "$NPM_CLI_INTEGRITY"
python3 - "$archive" <<'PY'
import pathlib
import sys
import tarfile

with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1], "r:gz") as archive_file:
    for member in archive_file.getmembers():
        path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name)
        if (
            path.is_absolute()
            or ".." in path.parts
            or member.issym()
            or member.islnk()
            or member.isdev()
            or member.isfifo()
        ):
            raise SystemExit(f"unsafe npm CLI archive member: {member.name}")
PY
tar --extract --gzip --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions \
  --file "$archive" --directory "$npm_cli_root"
npm_cli="$npm_cli_root/package/bin/npm-cli.js"
test -f "$npm_cli"
test ! -L "$npm_cli"
resolved_cli="$(realpath "$npm_cli")"
case "$resolved_cli" in
  "$npm_cli_root"/*) ;;
  *) echo "npm CLI escaped its temporary root" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
test "$("$resolved_cli" --version)" = "$NPM_CLI_VERSION"
echo "executable=$resolved_cli" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "integrity=$NPM_CLI_INTEGRITY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

commands.name: Run the latest Pi platform contract as a nonblocking canary
Publish the advisory upstream-compatibility receipt
commands.run:
# `shell: bash` runs with -eo pipefail, so the probe is wrapped: an
# absent or broken `pi` must degrade to "unresolved", never fail the
# receipt step and turn this advisory check red.
latest="$({ pi --version 2>/dev/null || true; } | tr -d '\r' | tail -n 1)"
[ -n "$latest" ] || latest="unresolved"
{
  echo "## Pi upstream compatibility (advisory)"
  echo
  echo "This is a WATCH lane. It reports whether npm-latest Pi is inside"
  echo "the validated support window; it never blocks merge."
  echo
  echo "| probe | outcome |"
  echo "| --- | --- |"
  echo "| npm latest Pi | \`$latest\` |"
  echo "| installed-runtime admission | \`$ADMISSION\` |"
  echo "| latest platform contract | \`$PLATFORM_CONTRACT\` |"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$ADMISSION" = success ] && [ "$PLATFORM_CONTRACT" = success ]; then
  echo "latest Pi ($latest) is inside the validated support window"
else
  echo "::warning title=Pi upstream compatibility::latest Pi ($latest) is outside the validated support window (admission=$ADMISSION, platform-contract=$PLATFORM_CONTRACT). Advisory only - run the Pi promotion workflow to validate and promote it."
fi

BASE="${BASE#refs/heads/}"
git fetch -q origin "$BASE" --tags
# Issue #435 scopes the payload (the plugin MINUS its tools/ BUILD
# directory, PLUS the committed esbuild artifacts inside it, since
# TypeScript sources and a lockfile never run on an installed machine).
# Issue #530 decides what makes a version unusable for a FURTHER
# payload change. Both rules live in Python so they can be unit-tested
# against a real repository rather than asserted about shell embedded
# in YAML - payload_scope.py and payload_version_gate.py, pinned by
# test_payload_scope.py and test_payload_version_gate.py.
#
# #530: this step used to ask "does tag v$ver exist?" and allow
# everything else. A marketplace install populates its cache from the
# MANIFEST VERSION with no tag involved, so an untagged-but-already-
# shipped version bought unlimited free payload changes that could
# reach no installed user. Three merged PRs shipped that way on 2.9.1.
python3 .github/scripts/payload_version_gate.py --plugin plugins/ca --base "origin/$BASE"
